arStrings.szText: Defensive Skill: Bellow a rallying cry. All allies move faster.
{c_important}Rallying Cry{/c} increases your Resource Generation by {c_number}[SF_10 * 100|%x|]{/c} and your Movement Speed by an additional {c_number}[SF_50 * 100 |%x|]{/c}.
{c_important}Rallying Cry's{/c} Fury Cost is reduced by {c_number}{SF_47}{/c} and it now Summons Madawc who upheaves the ground, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPHEAVAL_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Rallying Cry{/c} {c_important}{u}Dazes{/u}{/c} and Slows all enemies and their projectiles by {c_number}[SF_36 * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_53}{/c} seconds. 

{c_important}Rallying Cry{/c} also grants Attack Speed instead of Movement Speed and its Fury Cost is replaced with a {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} second Cooldown.
{c_important}Rallying Cry{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}[SF_43*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life when cast.
{c_important}Rallying Cry's{/c} duration is increased to {c_number}{SF_48}{/c} seconds.
For every {c_number}{SF_44}{/c} meter traveled while {c_important}Rallying Cry{/c} is active, restore {c_number}[{SF_41}]{/c} primary resource to yourself and half to nearby allies.

{c_important}Rallying Cry's{/c} effectiveness is increased by {c_number}[{SF_42}*100|%|]{/c} plus an additional {c_number}[{SF_51}*100|%|]{/c} for each ally affected, up to {c_number}[SF_51*SF_54*100|%|]{/c}.
